name: phased-as-normal
title: A phased package listed as a normal update
description: GetUpdates lists ubuntu-drivers-common with info 5; the python3 phasing stub reports phasing_applied 1 for it, so neither a row nor UpdatePackages may contain it (forbiddenIds: the fake records a violation if it arrives). GW2b (review m1): the simulate reports DownloadSizeRemaining 0 (the apt backend’s "unknown"), so the total comes from the download.
